purpose: Minimum-necessary logistics envelope for Shine Wellness handoffs to Concierge.
rules: Unknown top-level and nested fields are rejected rather than ignored.
Every source record reference is opaque; Concierge must not dereference Wellness tables directly.
The canonical record id must be included in sourceRecordIds.
Wellness plans may use only the wellness-care-logistics Concierge purpose.
All planned Wellness capability inputs are validated before the first specialist invocation.
nonClaims: This contract does not grant Vault access.
This contract does not grant Project L health-memory access.
This contract does not authorize clinical interpretation.
This contract does not certify any provider or specialist action as medically appropriate.
